request: Promote tested staged terminal Receiver, preserve previous instance for rollback

bounded_host_request.command: set -e; old=server-core-bounded-host; stage=server-core-bounded-host-stage-96d01bb; backup=server-core-bounded-host-pre-96d01bb; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$stage")" = running; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$old")" = running; ! docker inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1; docker rename "$old" "$backup"; if ! docker rename "$stage" "$old"; then docker rename "$backup" "$old"; exit 1; fi; docker inspect "$old" -f 'ACTIVE_RECEIVER={{.Config.Image}} STATUS={{.State.Status}}'; docker inspect "$backup" -f 'ROLLBACK_RECEIVER={{.Config.Image}} STATUS={{.State.Status}}'
